identity: VU full-time Dutch National Politics and Government BSc route, RIO 56606
confirmed: Adopted Dutch OER Articles 9.1, 10.4, 11.1–11.6, 12.1, and 14.1 plus Appendix III pp. 28–29. Years 1 and 2 each carry 60 EC, with two different restricted six-credit choices in year 2. Article 12 provides 30 EC open study subject to approval and level rules. Academic Skills 1 includes the Dutch diagnostic or remediation. Zero-credit mentorship applies in years 1 and 2. First-year binding advice threshold is 42 EC, subject to the regulation. The thesis rule sets a general threshold of 90 programme credits excluding open study including Academic Skills 1 and 2. No new-cohort final-year credit table was found.
unresolved: Confirm the final 30 EC for September 2026 National Politics and Government entrants, including credits and status of the three named final-year courses, the applicable thesis allocation and progression, and any third-year mentorship.
